messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.p99 latency breached 2.1s in us-west-2 for model 'redwood-large' — automatically escalated.

sara: ack, I'm on it. seeing p95 ~350ms, p99 ~2.1s, tail outliers on streaming decode. recent deploy shows kernel build trt8-20.1 rolled into pool-a around 02:00 UTC.

miguel: same here. KV cache eviction spikes correlate with the tail. host metrics show increased pagefaults and heavy memcpy stalls during decode.

joanne: tagging impacted customers — @CustomerAlpha and @CustomerGamma reported degraded live streaming. CS notified.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) reroute 20% traffic to us-east-1 fallback, 2) start kernel rollback on pool-a to trt8-19.8, 3) apply model-variant fallback (quant v1.2) and reduce streaming batch size. Doing step 1 now.

akshay: can run rollback playbook for kernel. playbook below. if rollback not safe, we'll shift to Dedicated fallback.

```
# rollback kernel on pool-a
invoke infra playbook rollback-kernel --pool pool-a --version trt8-19.8 --concurrency 5
# rollout model variant fallback
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/rollouts -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-large","variant":"v1.2-quant","percent":20}'
```

infra-ci: triggered job infra/rollback-7501234567, nodes 0/12 started. health checks will gate traffic for each node.

sara: also lowering streaming.batch_size to 1 on pool-a: `rbatch set pool-a streaming.batch_size=1` to reduce memory pressure during decode.

miguel: pulling logs from an affected host:

```
[2026-03-14T02:31:12Z] decode: pagefault at addr=0x7f9a3c000 len=65536, evicting kvcache
[2026-03-14T02:31:12Z] kernel: cuda_msync retry, stall 120ms
[2026-03-14T02:31:13Z] trace: streaming tail latency 2150ms
```

joanne: CustomerAlpha impact: 5% increase in retries and several timed-out sessions. CS has a DMA to affected accounts.

sara: ops-bot create_incident INC-7501234567 severity=sev2 impact=streaming_us-west-2

ops-bot: Incident INC-7501234567 created. Pager duty notified.

akshay: fallback plan B: if rollback fails or rollback velocity too slow — route remaining traffic to Dedicated pool-b (pinned trt8-19.8) and scale +30% capacity.

infra-ci: rollback progress: nodes 4/12 done, 8/12 pending. health checks green on the first two nodes, shifting 15% more traffic to stable nodes.

sara: p99 on rerouted traffic now 1.05s, overall p95 ~300ms. trending down but tail still visible on small percentage. keeping monitoring window open for 30m. capturing objdump and compile flags for postmortem.

miguel: saving traces and kvcache metrics to s3://redwood-telemetry/7501234567/ and linking to INC.

joanne: handoff note for next oncall @miguel: continue monitoring p99/p95, finish rollback, collate kernel git hash and exact compiler flags (LTO flags suspected). Prepare postmortem skeleton.

sara: ACK. quick summary for postmortem: regression introduced in trt8-20.1 combined with aggressive LTO/strip flags caused increased pagefaults and KV eviction under streaming decode workload, producing p99 tail spikes. Immediate mitigations: kernel rollback, traffic reroute to us-east-1, model-variant fallback to quant v1.2, lowered batch_size, Dedicated fallback if required. Customers notified, incident record created.

ops-bot: Incident INC-7501234567 updated: status=stabilized, severity=sev2, owners=[sara,miguel,akshay], impact=partial_degradation_streaming_us-west-2, next_update=30m.

sara: adding runbook step: `capture-objdump --kernel trt8-20.1 --out /tmp/7501234567-objdump.tar.gz` and attach to INC. Also will paste the compile flags in the PM.

miguel: will take the postmortem, will include perf histograms and KV eviction timelines. leaving channel, ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:

joanne: thanks all. will close thread after postmortem and customer follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
